content.rendered:
Walnut Creek Girl Scout Fundraiser and Father/Daughter Dance DJ.

DJ for Feb 7 2014 — Girl Scouts Father Daughter Dance at Walnut Heights

The theme this year was hollywood  what a blast everyone had. and also dont forget the photo booth.

Lots of hollywood songs, group participation, my girl, ymca, macarena, a great locomotion, father/daughter dances.

Last song of the night The Manhattans – You are my Shining Star
